_comment: Expected post-PO state for the default-mode feat-todo fixture. Asserted by runner.mjs --verify-po (after T-005 lands). Schema: each top-level key describes one assertion the runner checks; the runner prints PASS/FAIL per key. Mirrors conformance/expected/spec-driven-decomposition.json with paths adjusted for default-mode layout.

featureDirectoryExists._description: After PLAN, the default-mode feature directory must exist with us-1/ subdir populated.

specBodyValid._description: The default-mode spec body file is unchanged from the fixture (PO phase doesn't rewrite it).

exactlyOneStory._description: specification-agent should produce exactly 1 US for this fixture (1 functional requirement, no UI). Default-mode US lives at output/feats/feat-todo/us-N/us-N.md.

exactlyOneTask._description: Per protocol R2: 1 task per US when no PNG. The single task must be Type=Tech (no UI in this fixture). Default-mode task lives at output/feats/feat-todo/us-N/tasks/task-M.md.

noUITask._description: Anti-assertion: there must NOT be any task with Type=UI (no PNG in fixture, designer-agent skipped, frontend-agent should not be invoked).

noDesignSpec._description: Anti-assertion: no PNGs → no design-spec.md should be generated.

noErrorReportYet._description: PO phase doesn't run the correction loop; no error-report.md should exist after PLAN.

noShipMarkerYet._description: Anti-assertion: PLAN must NOT write the .pipeline-shipped marker (R1: PLAN/SHIP separation). Default-mode marker location is output/feats/feat-todo/.pipeline-shipped.
